title: Qualify destruction wait profiles
requires: Host fixture; one advertised native driver
scope: Test explicit completion and reference-runtime implicit device teardown waits with pending public objects.
acceptance: Accepted work drains before reference-driver device teardown returns, without use-after-free, hang or stale ownership after handle reuse.
Explicit completion avoids the implicit wait, and evidence does not generalize reference-runtime behavior to external drivers.
evidence: PASS Windows D3D12 NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 destruction-wait profile 20/20: pending work drained without hang; explicit completion verified copied bytes; replacement device submission proved no stale ownership.
PASS WSL GCC 13.3 host fixture 20/20: deterministic delayed producer remained pending at device teardown and copied output was complete before teardown returned.

PASS adjacent regressions: D3D12 lifecycle/validation/endpoint/teardown 4/4 and host queue/endpoint/failure/teardown 4/4; Visual Studio 18 and GCC 13.3 builds; generated API references and 19 roadmap unit tests passed.
